title: Possible overlap between PR #26 and PR #19?
body:
## Possible Overlap Between PR #26 and PR #19

PR #26 (jordan-lee's 'database pooling refactor') substantially overlaps with my PR #19 (auth caching). Both implement connection pooling in `src/utils/database.py`.

### Overlap
- Both add a `ConnectionPool` class
- Both modify `get_db_session()` to use pooling
- Both add `DATABASE_POOL_SIZE` config

### Question
I wanted to flag this in case it matters for merge planning. Is there a process for coordinating overlapping PRs?

/cc @sarah-kim

comments.body:
Adding context — I've been working on PR #19 for three weeks and noticed the overlap after Jordan's PR appeared.

Happy to coordinate with Jordan if the scope actually conflicts — just wanted visibility on this.
